# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# OneForAll 适配器测试夹具（.txt 后缀合规，测试运行时拷贝为临时目录 oneforall.py 执行）。
# 模拟 OneForAll 的 CLI 约定：--target <domain> --fmt json --path <out>，
# 并按 OneForAll 的行式 JSON 输出写 <out>/<domain>.json。
# 故意包含解析器要吃掉的脏形态：尾逗号、重复条目、前导点号子域、大写条目、非 JSON 行。
import json
import os
import sys


def _arg(name, default=None):
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    return args[args.index(name) + 1] if name in args else default


target = _arg("--target") or "example.com"
path = _arg("--path") or "."
rows = [
    {"subdomain": "api." + target},
    {"subdomain": ".dev." + target},
    {"subdomain": "api." + target},
    {"subdomain": "mail." + target},
]
out_path = os.path.join(path, target + ".json")
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for row in rows:
        f.write(json.dumps(row) + ",\n")
    f.write('{"subdomain": "MAIL.' + target + '"},\n')
    f.write("not-a-json-line,\n")
print("fake oneforall fixture done -> %s" % out_path)
